indication_area: Multiple sclerosis (improvement of walking in adults with walking disability)

approval_evidence.quote: FAMPYRA On July 20, 2011, the European Commission (EC) granted a conditional marketing authorization for FAMPYRA in the E.U., which triggered a $25.0 million milestone payment, which was paid to Acorda Therapeutics, Inc. (Acorda) in the third quarter of 2011. (Biogen Idec Form 10-Q for Q3 2011, filed 2011-10-28; FAMPYRA has no FDA approval - the U.S. product is Acorda's Ampyra)

launch_evidence.quote: FAMPYRA was commercially launched in Australia, Denmark, Germany, Norway and the U.K. in 2011. (Biogen Idec Form 10-K for 2011, filed 2012-02-03; the EC granted the conditional marketing authorization on July 20, 2011, and the first FAMPYRA revenue, $3,136 thousand, is printed for the three months ended September 30, 2011 in the 8-K Exhibit 99 filed 2011-10-28.)

series_start_reason: The EC granted FAMPYRA a conditional marketing authorization on July 20, 2011; Biogen's Q3 2011 release is the first to print a FAMPYRA revenue row (Q2 2011 release: no row), so the series starts at the launch quarter.
notes: Biogen's collaboration and license agreement for FAMPYRA global commercialization rights was terminated effective January 1, 2025 (10-Q for Q2 2026: 'Effective January 1, 2025, our collaboration and license agreement for FAMPYRA global commercialization rights was terminated.'). Biogen continued to print the FAMPYRA row; 2025 shows residual amounts and 2026 quarters print '—' (nil), kept as 0.
search_log: Listed every Biogen (CIK 875045) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned all 10-Q/10-K (2011-04 to 2026-11) and all 8-K with item 2.02 (2011-07 to 2026-11), plus the Q3 2019 earnings 8-K filed 2019-10-22 under item 9.01 only for 'FAMPYRA' in table rows and text (bin/scan.py; files biogen_periodic.txt, biogen_8k.txt).

Each quarter is the current three-month figure of that quarter's own earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1), including Q4, which every Q4 release prints as a three-month column; units are USD thousands in releases through Q3 2014 and USD millions from Q4 2014; from Q1 2016 the regional table (United States | Rest of world | Total) is used and Total taken.

Checks: quarters sum to the twelve-month figures printed in the Q4 releases / 10-Ks: 2011 3.136+10.433=13.569 (13.6 in 10-K); 2012 15.040+19.681+12.168+10.509=57.398; 2013 74.006; 2014 80.2; 2015 89.7; 2016 84.9; 2017 91.6; 2018 92.6 vs 92.7 printed; 2019 97.1; 2020 103.2 vs 103.1 printed; 2021 105.3 vs 105.2 printed (differences are rounding of one-decimal quarters); 2022 96.6; 2023 90.5; 2024 71.7; 2025 1.4 (computed in bin/b_biogen.py and printed below). 10-Q three-month figures match the releases where both exist.
Series runs to 2026Q2 because Biogen still prints the FAMPYRA row (as '—').
